callback_semantics.demand_operate: L2 RQ LOAD hit/miss only; RFO does not call operate
callback_semantics.prefetch_operate: PREFETCH callback occurs only for PF originating above L2; same-level SPP requests do not recursively invoke themselves; L1 prefetcher is none in actual formal build
callback_semantics.fill: L2 MSHR and writeback fill paths invoke cache_fill, including demand/RFO/PF/writeback fills. NativeSPP uses evicted_addr to update PREFETCH_FILTER and global feedback counters.
callback_semantics.features: SPP receives callback address, PC, cache_hit,type and fill/eviction callbacks; body uses address and private signature/pattern/filter/GHR state; PC/type/cache_hit are not directly consumed in invoke body
callback_semantics.contrast_nn: NN forward sees only PC/aligned address plus completed per-PC h/c. Shadow Stride is diagnostic, except explicit causal output-suppression experiment. No same-input claim across nativeSPP andNN.

guard_certificate.limitation: A finite tested-scenario guard certificate, not a proof for every trace/state/configuration or a synthesized finite-service SPP implementation.

spp_native.cost_model: Native functional SPP has no modeled finite compute/lookup throughput or nonlinear engine. Its IPC is a strong conventional functional baseline, not a demonstrated finite-cost hardware implementation.
